overview_description.description: Maliyya is a fully Shariah-compliant P2P financing and investment startup.  Maliyya aims to disrupt the financial and investment services industry through bringing together regional and global financiers and borrowers.  Maliyya plans to use the big data, artificial intelligence and blokchain technologies to provide investors and borrowers with the most optimal solutions for investing or mobilizing financing.
